why: tripwire: S&P 500 down -8.6% in a week
key_risks: Binary escalation risk in the Strait of Hormuz/Gulf: further strikes (after Qeshm, Bahrain drone attack, Saudi infrastructure hits) could spike oil sharply beyond the +6% forecast, hitting Consumer Discretionary/Industrials/Technology hardest per the oil-shock table.
Binary risk from OPEC+ Ministerial meeting on November 29 regarding 2027 quota decisions.
Binary: Dec 8-9 FOMC; the dot plot implies a hike to ~4.1. A hawkish surprise pushes 10y past 5% and extends the selloff.
Binary: Nov 29 OPEC+ quota decision; a large increase undercuts the oil-up view.

CALC:recession_risk (0.299, elevated) is being driven largely by the equity drawdown itself and a flattish-but-positive curve; NFCI loose (-0.48) argues against an imminent credit crunch, but a continued HY spread widening trend could flip this quickly.

Credit spread widening (3.52, 86-92nd percentile) combined with VIX at 92nd percentile and SPX -6% below its 200dma is a classic pullback setup the CALC:pullback_risk model (p=0.15, 'normal') may be underweighting since its own top driver (S&P vs 200dma) is already negative.

December 8-9 FOMC (NOTE:A1) with fresh SEP: given inflation accelerating and the Fed's own 4.1% 2026 dot vs current 3.88% funds rate, a hawkish surprise (no cut signaled, hawkish dots) could re-price the whole curve.
December 8-9 FOMC meeting delivering a hawkish surprise if the Fed emphasizes 4.08% CPI over financial market volatility.
Financial contagion and forced de-risking after the -8.6% weekly S&P 500 drop, triggering sharp high-yield credit spread widening beyond 400 bp.
Geopolitical escalation leading to direct destruction of Persian Gulf oil infrastructure, driving Brent oil above $110/bbl.

Geopolitical escalation: Houthi/Iran strikes on Saudi export capacity could spike oil well beyond +3%; a de-escalation/Hormuz reopening could drop it 20% (Energy -6.5 vs SPY under the oil-shock table).
OPEC+ ministerial meeting Nov 29 deciding 2027 quotas, against IEA's forecast of a supply rebound to 108.1mb/d in 2027 — a cut vs. hold decision could swing oil meaningfully.
Pullback model likely understates risk: VIX 28.44, HY 3.52 widening, S&P 6% below its 200-day.
Recession model elevated at 0.299 but contradicted by Sahm 0 and low claims; a weak Dec 4 payrolls print would validate it.
